name: Cables
description: Cables carry power and fluids between your machines (to move items, use a drone with a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport Module$(/l)). Every kind $(l)connects by itself$() to cables of the same kind and to any block that accepts what it carries, from CyberFarm or any other mod. Each kind comes in $(l)three tiers$(), told apart by the ring where two cables meet: grey, $(l)gold$() and $(l)violet$().
